preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 1000 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) >= 3])
preconditions.description: Each test case has N between 3 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for N, A in [(int(stdin.readline()), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split()))) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each test case's array A has exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 for A in [list(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(T)] for x in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in A is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: any('YES' in line or 'NO' in line for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output for each test case starts with either YES or NO.

postconditions.expression: all('NO' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'NO')
postconditions.description: If the answer is NO, the line contains only 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N and len(C) == N for N, B, C in [(int(stdin.readline()), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split())), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split()))) if 'YES' in line else (0, [], []) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the next two lines contain exactly N integers each for B and C.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(B) == sorted(A) and sorted(C) == sorted(A) for A, B, C in [(list(map(int, stdin.readline().split())), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split())), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split()))) if 'YES' in line else ([], [], []) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: B and C are permutations of the original array A.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(sorted(B[i-1:j]) == sorted(C[i-1:j]) for i in range(1, N+1) for j in range(i, N+1) if (i, j) != (1, N)) for N, B, C in [(int(stdin.readline()), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split())), list(map(int, stdin.readline().split()))) if 'YES' in line else (0, [], []) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For YES cases, no subarray B[i:j] is a permutation of C[i:j] for any 1 ≤ i ≤ j ≤ N except when (i, j) = (1, N).
